name: Thorlan04 B2B Intelligence & E-Commerce MCP Suite
description: Model Context Protocol tools for EU company legal compliance checks (SIREN/SIRET/VIES VAT/GDPR/EAA 2025), high-speed Shopify JSON catalog monitoring, and automated B2B web-to-markdown RAG extraction.

tools.name: audit_eu_b2b_compliance
tools.description: Audits a European company website for legal compliance (SIREN, SIRET, VAT VIES), GDPR privacy standards, EAA 2025 accessibility, and AI-Readiness (llms.txt).

targetUrl.description: The URL of the company website to audit (e.g. https://example.com).

checkVies.description: Whether to validate VAT numbers against official EU VIES registry.

checkEaa.description: Check European Accessibility Act (EAA 2025) compliance indicators.

tools.name: scrape_shopify_catalog_json
tools.description: Crawls and extracts full product catalogs, variants, prices, and stock levels from any public Shopify store using high-speed JSON feeds.

shopifyStoreUrl.description: Base URL of the target Shopify store (e.g. https://store.example.com).

maxProducts.description: Maximum number of products to extract.

collection.description: Optional specific collection handle to scrape.

tools.name: execute_b2b_autopilot_pipeline
tools.description: Runs comprehensive B2B pipeline: extracts clean Markdown, analyzes compliance, monitors e-commerce catalogs, and generates llms.txt manifests.

targetUrl.description: Target website URL for extraction, compliance audit, or catalog monitoring.
